title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2001, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2001, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the sports category, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
